Its core function is to maintain a sealed intake state, enabling deterministic scoring and yielding +6.77 pp over win-probability-max. This implies a dualism between estimation and inference: the intake is not a model per se but a data kernel that feeds into probabilistic inference layers. The failure mode occurs when nulls are not handled deterministically, e.g., in Pittsburgh week-4 offensive line data. Field arithmetic ensures consistency across attempts and rows, while Alexandria search provides open-access context without persistent keys. The system is designed to resist retroactive updates or retraining, enforcing a static, sealed operational regime.
